items.title: Dark red warning button & End Combat Copy Log
items.do: With Durgan Dying or Shattered, try to end combat (opens "End the encounter?" warning), then actually end a combat with Aveline, Durgan, and Goblin Sneak (opens "The encounter ends").
items.expect: "End it anyway" is deep crimson with crisp light text (not pastel pink); "The encounter ends" includes a "Copy Encounter Log (archived)" button that copies the report without closing the dialog, and the finished fight stays accessible in Encounter Log's Archive dropdown.

items.title: Upgraded Encounter Log (Health Pressure %, Unified IDs, Archive)
items.do: Run a round or two of combat with Aveline, Durgan, Sylwen, Kaela against Ogre Chieftain, Orc Warrior, and two Goblin Sneaks (including a Shield of Faith or Judge reduction, a Critical or Bloodied hit, a passed Reaction, and an Undo on a damage card), then open Encounter Log from 2d12 Tools.
items.expect: Summary & Health % tab shows Raw, Reduced, Net ([V]/[R]), Max HP, Heal (RP), Current, Taken %, Attempted %, Party Total with G9 difficulty band, Prevented credit for Durgan/Aveline, and identical Goblin Sneak 1/2 numbering across Encounter Log and Damage Report; Undo does not log as a Heal; Copy for Analysis copies the full Markdown report cleanly.

items.title: Image-1 World Clock, Above-Chat Time Bar & button centering
items.do: Open World Clock from 2d12 Tools and check the quick time bar above chat (with Aveline on the scene); also glance at button/icon centering in Initiative, Pick dialogs, and 2d12 Tools.
items.expect: World Clock shows stacked uppercase date over bold gold HH:MM:SS with centered "+ 1 Round / + 1 Min / + 10 Min" and labeled Dawn/Noon/Dusk/Night buttons; the above-chat time bar uses dark STYLE-3 buttons (no white buttons) with stacked day/time readout; buttons and icons across dialogs sit dead-center.
